guitar.evidence: Albert Hammond Jr.'s Epiphone Riviera and Nick Valensi's Stratocasters/Gibson ES models are reasonably documented from the early-2000s NYC rock revival era.

tone.target: bright compressed garage-pop crunch with dry room
tone.profile: bright compressed garage-pop crunch with dry room
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a Boost for compression and initial drive, followed by the UK 50 amp model with a small reverb to achieve the signature garage-pop crunch.
